license_of_package_authorship: CC BY 4.0 for original synthetic structure and prose; third-party sources retain their own terms.
scope: Fictional twelve-country educational economy; public, citeable, free/open-access source registry only.

files.model_formula_catalog.md: formula cards, test cases, derivations and limits
files.market_baselines.json: market, logistics, project and contract schemas
files.shock_library.json: scenario shocks and observed case anchors
files.sources.md: source registry, access terms, versions and replacements

validation.json: parse every .json file as UTF-8 JSON
validation.csv: require unique variable_id and no unknown status
validation.provenance: all provenance IDs must resolve in sources.md or be a documented derived profile
validation.units: reject currency unit mixing and percent-versus-fraction ambiguity
validation.policy_checks: lag <= peak <= max duration; coefficient min <= central <= max
validation.snapshot_rule: never overwrite a released scenario's observed anchor or calibration version

replacement_policy: Do not silently revise history. Add a new source record/version and retain prior scenario snapshots. Mark superseded source records with deprecated_at and replacement_id in the next package release.
